abstract:
PURPOSE: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) has high rates of early recurrence (ER), occult metastasis, and poor survival despite curative-intent therapy. Predictive factors and models span clinical, biomarker, imaging, radiomics, pathologic, and molecular domains, but clinical readiness remains uncertain.
METHODS: We performed a systematic review in accordance with Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses. Five databases were searched for studies evaluating predictors or models of PDAC recurrence, metastasis, lymph node metastasis (LNM), occult metastatic disease, disease-free survival (DFS) or recurrence-free survival, or recurrence patterns. Studies were screened and coded for end point, modality, model type, validation, discrimination, calibration, clinical utility, and predictor timing.
RESULTS: Of 234 full-text records, 208 studies were included, comprising 144 prediction models and 64 predictor/prognostic factor studies. Computed tomography/radiomics (141/208), clinical/electronic health record variables (104/208), and serum/urine biomarkers (46/208) were the most common modalities. External validation, calibration, and decision-curve analyses were reported in 52, 36, and 38 model studies, respectively. AUCs ranged from 0.70 to 0.92 for ER, 0.75-0.95 for LNM, and 0.71-0.88 for liver or occult metastasis; DFS/relapse-free survival models had C-indices of 0.62-0.82. One externally validated occult-metastasis model had a C-statistic of 0.56. Model maturity was limited by retrospective design, heterogeneous end points, incomplete calibration reporting, and postoperative variables in preoperative models.
CONCLUSION: Prediction models for PDAC recurrence and metastatic progression are rapidly expanding, particularly through radiomics, machine learning, and multimodal modeling. Clinical translation requires decision-aligned design, transparent reporting, external validation, calibration, interpretability, and prospective evaluation of clinical utility.
key_points_ko: 분석에 포함된 208건 중 144건이 예측 모델 연구였으며, CT/라디오믹스(141건)와 임상 정보(104건)가 주로 활용되었습니다.
조기 재발(AUC 0.70~0.92) 및 림프절 전이(AUC 0.75~0.95) 예측 모델들은 양호한 판별력을 보였습니다.
외부 검증(52건), 보정 분석(36건), 임상 결정 곡선 분석(38건)이 보고된 비율이 낮아 실제 진료 현장 적용에는 한계가 있었습니다.
summary_ko: 이 연구는 췌관선암(PDAC)의 재발, 전이, 림프절 전이 등을 예측하는 모델과 인자들을 분석한 체계적 문헌고찰 연구입니다. 총 208건의 연구(예측 모델 144건, 예후 인자 연구 64건)를 검토한 결과, 컴퓨터단층촬영(CT)/라디오믹스 및 임상 정보가 가장 흔히 활용되었습니다. 조기 재발 예측 정확도(AUC)는 0.70~0.92, 무병 생존기간(DFS) 예측 C-index는 0.62~0.82 수준으로 보고되었습니다. 연구진은 많은 모델이 후향적 연구에 기반하고 외부 검증이나 보정 평가가 부족하여 실제 임상 적용을 위해서는 전향적 평가가 필요하다고 결론지었습니다.
title: Toward Clinically Actionable Prediction of Recurrence and Metastatic Progression in Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma: A Systematic Review
